title: Red Teaming AI: Finding the Fault Lines Before Attackers Do
description: A complete course on adversarial testing of AI systems: why models fail, the full attack taxonomy (prompt injection, jailbreaks, poisoning, extraction), the red team process used by Microsoft and the frontier labs, the open-source tooling (PyRIT, garak, ART), real-world incidents from Tay to Grand Theft Claude, and the NIST/EU/ISO governance landscape.
